image_description: A close-up, vertical shot of a pelican (likely an Australian Pelican or similar species) floating on green water. The bird is facing right, with its head turned slightly towards the viewer. It features white plumage on the head and neck, transitioning to black and grey mottled feathers on the back and wings. The distinctive long bill with a large, pinkish-orange gular pouch is clearly visible. The background is a smooth, out-of-focus teal/green water surface.
